notes.title: Build - v.4.45.0
notes.content:
[b]Quick use menu[/b]

Starting with version 4.45, you can now pin any usable item to the right side of the screen for quick access. For example, in the video, you’ll see the HP Potion pinned for convenient use.

Key Details:
Pin & Unpin Easily: Hold to pin or unpin an item as needed.
Multiple Items: Pin up to 5 different items simultaneously.
Includes Portal Scrolls: Yes, portal scrolls can be pinned too!
Level Up Notification
We’re introducing small but highly unticipated feature! A level up effect that will appear right after battling and defeating the monster!


[b]New Sound Effects and Animations for Milestone Points[/b]

As part of our commitment to enhancing quality, we’re rolling out a fresh, attractive animation for claiming milestone points during events. After claiming, you’ll see currencies visually fly up to their designated display areas, creating a more intuitive experience.

Addressing Player Feedback:
Many of you shared feedback that having two different points—pass rewards and milestones—displayed one above the other was causing confusion. To solve this, the new animation clearly indicates where each set of points is allocated, ensuring better clarity and smoother gameplay.


[b]And much more[/b]

- Equipment & Skins Tabs
- World Tier Loot System fixes
- Bugtracker support
- Dozens of small fixes and quality improvements.

notes.title: New Feature in Miners Settlement: Introducing Elemental Gems!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Funventurers[/b]
We’re excited to announce the arrival of a groundbreaking feature in Miners Settlement – Elemental Gems! This new system brings a fresh layer of customization, allowing you to enhance your equipment and make your adventures even more powerful and strategic. Let’s dive into the details!

[h1]What Are Elemental Gems?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/1a12122267997bad5ef51f04813d2291310fd8f4.png[/img]

Elemental Gems are magical stones that can be socketed into weapons and off-hand items to boost your stats. Each gem embodies one of the six core elements:

[olist]
[*] Fire
[*] Water
[*] Earth
[*] Wind
[*] Lightning
[*] Physical
[/olist]

By inserting it into Main Hand you will boost your damage, Off-hand defence. With gems, you can fine-tune your build to fit your preferred playstyle or take on specific challenges in the game.


[h1]How to Use Elemental Gems[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/4cb1af3d4984d39c6e30d3a99f8dfe0b6f72a390.png[/img]
[h2]Socket Your Gems[/h2]
Create slots in your equipment and insert the desired gem. Note: once a gem is inserted, it cannot be removed without destroying it, so choose wisely!

[h2]Upgrade Your Gems[/h2]
Combine lower-tier gems to create higher-tier ones. The system allows upgrades up to Tier 21, each tier offering significantly improved stats. For example, Fire Gems scale as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/39f2f6934a47a770127271ce304e076d4ddacaf7.png[/img]

[h1]How to Obtain Gems[/h1]

[h2]Explore World Chests[/h2]
In Mitar, new World Chests are scattered across the region. These chests always contain at least one gem. Their locations change daily, so log in regularly to find and open them.

[h2]Defeat Monsters and Bosses[/h2]
The ongoing war in Mitar revolves around these precious gems. All monsters have a small chance of dropping them, while bosses offer the highest drop rates.

[h2]Participate in Events[/h2]
To celebrate this feature’s launch, we’re introducing a special merging and gem-hunting event. Participate to earn extra rewards and speed up your gem journey!

[h2]Trade on the Open Market[/h2]
The Open Market is now open for Tier 1–9 gems. Buy, sell, or trade gems with other players to complete your collection.

[h2]Socketing: New Slots in Items[/h2]
Starting today, all newly dropped items may include gem slots based on their quality:

[olist]
[*] Epic: 1 slot (30% chance for at least 1 slot)
[*] Legendary: 1-2 slots (28% chance for at least 1 slot)
[*] Relic: 1-3 slots (17,5% chance for at least 1 slot)
[*] Mythic: 1-4 slots (11% chance for at least 1 slot)
[*] Mythic Plus: 1-5 slots (11% chance for at least 1 slot)
[/olist]

You can also create slots in your existing items using gems of all six elements. The cost varies depending on the item’s quality and the slot’s level.

[h1]Infinite Progression Awaits[/h1]
The Elemental Gems system is designed to be an endgame feature, providing endless opportunities for growth. And this is just the beginning! Soon, we’ll introduce Rifts, offering infinite daily progress and possibility to compete with other players!

As always, you can find more information on our official site:
https://www.minerssettlement.funventure.eu

notes.title: HALLOWEEN SEASON
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/e2ca84706dd2ca7c34ac9c26e69e669a7f2e22e4.png[/img]
It's packed to the brim with scary, spooky content, but also has plenty of treats for you to collect! Join us for the fun!

Each event on this list also offers Halloween-themed rewards such as Halloween Candy or Halloween Rift Ticket.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/139fdcf700c3ce1f5599d74861ba3a2eab891284.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Slayer's Way - Defeat as many enemies as you can and earn valuable rewards for your efforts.

[*] Chest Boost - The marketplace offers the chance to obtain more valuable rewards from chests. Take advantage while it lasts!

[*] Fate's Gambit - Defeat enemies to earn silver tickets, spin the wheels to receive door tickets, and explore one of 11 locations to gain valuable rewards.

[*] Daily Reward - A Daily Reward Token appears next to the house every 23 hours, which counts towards the Daily Reward Event. Active players will be able to claim all rewards from the list.

[*] Nightwing - Discover the Nightwing map, collect tokens, unlock new runewords, and defeat hordes of enemies. There are 21 locations to explore.

[*] Guild Chest - Guild members can collect points throughout the week to choose and open a chest with the leader during the weekend! Valuable rewards await!

[*] Guild Decoration - Get ready for Halloween decorations. Collect points with your guildmates to unlock the decorations that appeal to you the most.

[*] Trick Or Treat - Complete tasks to earn trick-or-treats that you can send to your friends or foes!

[*] Haunted Manor - Explore the haunted mansion filled with ghosts and ghouls to earn valuable rewards and unique Halloween skins.

[*] Pumpkin Picnic - Farm pumpkins and earn additional points for the Haunted Manor along with valuable rewards.

[*] Spooky Pets - This event gives you a unique chance to obtain Halloween pets. Complete tasks, level up pets, and claim one for free!

[*] Graveyard Rush - It’s time to return to the graveyard, which offers extra loot that counts towards Haunted Manor points and valuable rewards.

[*] Halloween Rift - A brand new dungeon with new loot! Collect Halloween Rift Keys from other events starting today.

[*] Phantom Drake - The deadliest of all dragons awaits you! Complete tasks, gather keys for Phantom Drake, and defeat one of its forms. Valuable rewards are waiting to be claimed!

[/list]
We wish you a great game and a spooky Halloween!

The calendar may be updated throughout Halloween.

notes.title: Update 4.43 – Armors & Legs
notes.content:
Hello, Funventurers!

We have some exciting news for you! Version[b] [url=https://minerssettlement.funventure.eu/update-4-43-armors-legs/]4.43[/url][/b] of “[b]Miners Settlement[/b]” is starting to roll out on your devices across [b]Steam[/b], [b]Android[/b], and [b]iOS[/b] platforms. This update lays the groundwork for an amazing [b]seasons 2024[/b] we have ahead, kicking off with the upcoming [b]Halloween event![/b]

[h1]New Gear Slots: Armors and Legs Support[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/8d4f3ebe981fb5528428f15b2fd1f65eedc033fa.png[/img]

Your characters are about to be even better equipped! We’ve added two new gear slots in preparation for armors and legs. While the items themselves will be released shortly after, this update ensures that the game is ready to support them. Get ready for an incredible adventure with new gear and exciting events!

[h1]Sneak Peek of the Halloween Event[/h1]
[previewyoutube=6SxEejm0dMY;full][/previewyoutube]

As a little sneak peek of what’s to come, we’re thrilled to introduce the [b]Doom Set[/b], which will be available during the [b]Halloween event[/b]. The set includes:
[list]
[b][*] Halloween Wings Skin
[*] Halloween Armor Skin
[*] Halloween Legs Skin
[*] Halloween Sword Skin
[*] Halloween Shield Skin[/b][/list]
This is just a taste of the spooky and thrilling content we have planned for you.

[h1]Enhance Your Gear Easier Than Ever[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/d412412189f10ea576f12224322999bc1c495232.png[/img]

Listening to your feedback, we’ve introduced an [b]enhance button directly in the gear popup[/b]. No more running to the Enhance Stone! Now you can enhance your equipment anytime, anywhere, allowing you to progress faster from the very beginning of the game.

[h1]Thank You and Apologies[/h1]

We want to [b]thank[/b] everyone who helped us over the past three weeks in finding and reporting bugs. You are amazing! We also [b]apologize[/b] for any issues caused by the major architecture change. We hope you’re already feeling how the game has become more responsive. If you encounter any problems, please let us know—we’re here for you!

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]

This is just the beginning! Soon, we’ll be releasing the new armors and legs items, bringing [b]hundreds of new drops[/b] and incredible gaming experiences to “Miners Settlement”. And don’t forget—the [b]Halloween event[/b] is just around the corner, packed with exclusive items and spooky fun!

Thank you for being with us and for creating this amazing community. See you in the game!

With warm regards,
[i]Your Funventure Team[/i]

notes.title: Hornbane Rebel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/166149465f0f76a714a2362d3a9d11f34edd9b3c.png[/img]
[h1]What, where, and how?[/h1]

Event Boss has 5 forms, each with a separate entrance. The first entrance is located next to the guild building. To see the entrance, you need to have the appropriate Token:
[list]
[*] Boss Lvl 1 - Common Boss Token
[*] Boss Lvl 2 - Rare Boss Token
[*] Boss Lvl 3 - Epic Boss Token
[*] Boss Lvl 4 - Legendary  Boss Token
[*] Boss Lvl 5 - Relic Boss Token
[/list]
All entrances to Boss are located within Virimel.

The last Boss is infused through the 3 portals. To defeat it, you must first destroy all the portals that empower it. The portals only appear if you have at least one Relic Boss Token

[h1]Where can i find them?[/h1]
One is located in Virimel
One is located in Mitar
And one in Einlor

Chances of obtaining a Boss Token:
[list]
[*] Boss Lvl 1 - Rare Boss Token -> 100%
[*] Boss Lvl 2 - Epic Boss Token -> 80%
[*] Boss Lvl 3 - Legendary  Boss Token -> 70%
[*] Boss Lvl 4 - Relic Boss Token  -> 55%
[*] Boss Lvl 5 - Mythic Boss Token -> 40%
[*] Boss Lvl 5 - Boss Pet Part -> 10%
[/list]

The Event ends 1st February

Let the hunt begin!

notes.title: Chest Boost
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/b39e46b08d8379eb9cb96233aab4e98367c07de2.png[/img]

We have heard your feedback, and we have adjusted the cost of the chest.

We changed the cost in the [b]Trade Coin[/b] to [b]Chest Tickets - Permanent[/b].

[h1]How do you obtain Chest Tickets?[/h1]

You acquire Chest Tickets by exchanging gears that accumulate in your inventory or are too weak to sell on the open market. This provides you with an additional chance to get better gear. We want the Chest Tickets to be a permanent thing.

[h1]What can you exchange?[/h1]

There will be different exchanges every day, but currently, you can exchange epic, legendary, and relic quality gear for tickets. The rest of the gear items can be used for melting down into Sacred Soul Stones.

[b]The event lasts until December 15 at 9 UTC.[/b]

Until then, there will be an active chest with a chance for amulets.

The second chest with a chance for the Stellar Puppy Pet will disappear the next day.

We hope that these changes will have a positive impact on your gaming experience. We also reserve the right to make further adjustments and conduct testing if it has a negative impact on the game and economy. 

[b]We wish you a great game![/b]

notes.title: Character Abilities
notes.content:
We would like to thank all players for their testing and patience. We are pleased to inform you that the Ability Tree will be made available to all players on [b]Friday, November 10th at 9 AM UTC.[/b]
 
[b]What is the Ability Tree?[/b]
Upon reaching each hero level, players receive 1 ability point that they can allocate to available statistics.
Maximum level the player receives points for is Hero Level 200.
Maximum pool of points in the skill tree is 720.
So, everyone will have the opportunity to choose the statistics or effects that suit them best.
 
[b]What bonuses does the Ability Tree include?[/b]
[list]
[*] Attack
[*] Defense
[*] Hero Speed
[*] Attack Speed
[*] Elemental Damage - Fire/Wind/Water/Earth/Lightning
[*] Elemental Defense - Fire/Wind/Water/Earth/Lightning
[/list]
[b]What if I distributed the points incorrectly?[/b]
No worries. There is an option to reset the allocated statistics. One such token is available in a new side quest requiring the player to reach level 10. More can be acquired for ingame currency.

We wish you further character development and finding the optimal path for hero ability tree!

notes.title: PVP Runewords Update
notes.content:
As Funventure, we sincerely value the active engagement of our players!
After carefully analyzing their battles and survey responses, we have decided to introduce [b]changes to the runewords[/b] in order to enhance the PvP experience. These adjustments aim to make battles more engaging, strategic, and provide a wider range of possibilities for countering opponents effectively.

Based on survey answers and our observations, we've identified that [b]stun is a significant issue in PvP[/b]. While we understand its value as an alternative approach, we agree that some nerfs are necessary. To address this, [b]we have shortened the stun duration and reduced its chances[/b].

We will closely monitor the impact of these changes in PvP and continue to balance it as needed in the future. [b]Your feedback is invaluable in making our game better![/b] 

[olist]
[*] Virimel Guard: increased extra defense from 100 to 200.
[*] Death Steam: Critical hit chance changed from 25% to 10%, damage changed from 150% to 200%.
[*] Every single elemental resist runeword increased from 100 to 450.
[*] Warboss: stun duration decreased from 1sec. to 0.5
[*] Poison Web: stun chance decreased 50% to 35%.
[*] Anihilation Strike: chance decreased from 5% to 4% and Critical attack from 500% to 400%.
[*] Elemental Sacrifice: elemental defenses increased from 200 to 250, no longer decreasing health and defense.
[*] Battle Fury: increased physical dmg from 100 to 250.
[*] Single elemental damage runewords increased damage from 200 to 250.
[*] New runword Defensive Stance: 1500 health points, 100+ physical defense, 100 every elemental defense.
[/olist]

notes.title: Search And Rescue
notes.content:
[b]Calling all heroes![/b]
A dire situation awaits, and it is you who holds the power to make a difference in the lives of innocent creatures. Welcome to the gripping adventure of Search And Rescue.

A dark shadow has fallen upon our lands as vile [b]poachers[/b] roam, seeking to capture and harm our beloved animals. It is a race against time to confront these heartless foes, for the fate of these creatures hangs in the balance. Brace yourself for an intense battle that will test your strength, courage, and unwavering determination.

The quest begins as you embark on a mission to locate and liberate every captured animal scattered throughout the vast expanse of the game world. Each rescue will not only free these magnificent beings from captivity but also strike a blow against the oppressive forces that seek to exploit them. As you set them free, a glimmer of hope will shine through the darkness.

Throughout your valiant efforts, you will come across [b]Rescue Tokens[/b], a testament to your compassion and bravery. They can be exchanged for valuable rewards. Your selfless acts of liberation shall be acknowledged, and the rewards will serve as a symbol of gratitude for your unwavering dedication.

The choice is yours, hero. The time has come to embark on the noble quest of Search And Rescue. The animals await your heroic intervention, counting on your unwavering spirit to set them free from the clutches of darkness.

[b]What, where, how?[/b]
[list]
[*] Locate all the animals scattered throughout the game and set them free
[*] Defeat the enemies
[*] Collect Rescue Tokens for releasing the animals and exchange them for valuable rewards
[/list]
Good luck!

notes.title: PVP Update
notes.content:
This PvP introduction is currently in its [b]first testing phase[/b], and the Virimel Arena is being established. We've also implemented [b]PvP Build Equipment[/b], entirely separate from the storyline builds to prevent build swapping. This means even if you are using different items in the storyline, your character will battle in the Arena with the build you've chosen.

[b]We have adjusted the runic words specifically for PvP[/b] to ensure that equipment plays a crucial role and runic words are not overpowered. However, [b]we anticipate some changes in the runic words based on your feedback.[/b] We will be seeking your opinions and strive to involve you in public polls for this. We are looking forward to experiencing this PvP journey together!

As mentioned, the [b]ranking resets monthly[/b], to keep things competetive and fresh. For the most tenacious heroes, we have lined up valuable rewards as a testament to your resilience and skills.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44245420/04a1593e443838e742a8b213d85bab2969dea4ab.png[/img]

[h1]Plans for the future of PVP[/h1]

As we continue our PvP journey in Virimel, we are excited to [b]give you a glimpse of what's coming in our second version.[/b]

[b]The Arena[/b], a vibrant embodiment of the Virimel spirit, is currently under construction. Soon, you will witness its grandeur both externally and internally. Its design is meticulously planned to mirror the bravado of the champions who will set foot in it. The grandeur of the structure and the excitement of the battles within will create an ambiance unlike any other.

We also understand that our heroes love to stand out in the crowd, and to cater to this, we will be launching a [b]dedicated PvP shop[/b]. Here, [b]you'll be able to customize your hero with unique skins and auras[/b], letting you personalize your champion to reflect your style and spirit.

Lastly, we've planned something extra special to make the Virimel town even more captivating. [b]The town will be decked out in the colors and emblem of the guild with the highest cumulative ELO score in the top 200 ranking.[/b] This visual honor is dynamic and will change as the ranking fluctuates, ensuring the town constantly echoes the achievement of its champions. The thrill of seeing your guild's colors fluttering around town is sure to fuel the competitive spirit!

These are just a few of the thrilling features planned for our second version. Stay tuned as we continue to bring more innovative and exciting updates to the world of Virimel PvP!
